requirements.tolerance_notes: ASMedia documents examined do not state capacitor tolerance. +/-5% is an RX selection target to improve margin over +/-10%, not an ASMedia requirement. Temperature, DC bias, aging, ESD stress and channel loss still require qualification.

usb_if_2019_design_presentation_page_49.package: Consider 0201 for lower parasitics and better return loss than 0402.

usb4_normative_reference.note: Verified directly in the November 2025 normative specification, not only the 2019 presentation.

RX_selection_priority.user_preference: Retain EIA 0201 and >=25 V. User accepts the existing +/-10% Murata RX part for the first prototype, including the initial lower-limit margin concern.
RX_selection_priority.engineering_selection_target: Earlier +/-5% target is superseded for this prototype. Selected part is GRM033R61E334KE15D, 330 nF, 25 V, +/-10%, X5R, EIA 0201.
RX_selection_priority.assessment: Accepted prototype choice. Its 297-363 nF initial interval does not guarantee the USB4 300-363 nF requirement. Temperature, DC bias and aging add uncertainty. No production qualification is implied.
RX_selection_priority.cold_temperature_priority: Secondary; user accepts a weaker limit.

reference_documents.notes: ASMedia ASM2464PD/PDX PCB Guideline (Mid loss), revision 1.0, July 3, 2023. PDF page 3 specifies 220 nF TX and 330 nF RX, both 0201/X7R. Original download URL is not recorded.
Candidate only, not instantiated. Manufacturer sheet confirms 330 nF, +/-5%, 25 V, X7R, EIA 0603 (1608 metric). This package differs from the ASMedia 0201 recommendation.

USB-IF design presentation, November 20, 2019. PDF page 49 compares 0201 and 0402 capacitor footprints and recommends considering 0201 for lower parasitics and better return loss. The example does not establish performance for this board. Connector-facing TX capacitors: 135-265 nF, 25 V; RX: 300-363 nF, 25 V.

Yageo X7R catalog, revision 27, March 6, 2026. PDF page 4 lists EIA 0201 at 25 V up to 10 nF; no 220 nF or 330 nF 0201 entries. EIA 0402 includes 220 nF at 25 V, but no 330 nF. This establishes a limitation of this manufacturer catalog, not proof of global unavailability.

USB4 Specification 2.0, November 2025, CLEAN PDF extracted unchanged from the official bundle. PDF page 93 (printed page 49), section 3.1.2.2 requires connector-facing RX capacitance 300-363 nF and discharge resistance 200-242 kohm for Gen 2/Gen 3. TX capacitance is 135-265 nF.
Manufacturer model list, downloaded October 14, 2026. PDF page 8 lists 330 nF EIA 0201 X5R at 25 V and 35 V, all +/-10%. This model list is not necessarily a complete product catalog.

General Purpose Ceramic Capacitors C Series, revision 05/2026-A. PDF page 3 restricts X5R tolerance to K/M (+/-10% or +/-20%). Generic front-page tighter tolerance codes do not establish an X5R +/-5% option.

PDF page 2: +/-15% temperature change from -55 to +85 C, with no cold-temperature exception stated. Downloaded through POST /part/download.do with masterKey=CL03A334KA3NRN&type=specsheet. Stronger stated cold-temperature limit than the saved Murata reference sheet, not a guarantee of 300-363 nF or USB4 channel performance.

RX_alternative.assessment: New part-specific evidence: Samsung reference sheet page 2 specifies +/-15% temperature change across -55 to +85 C, without the saved Murata sheet's -33% cold exception. This improves the stated cold-temperature limit only. Initial tolerance remains +/-10%, so 300-363 nF and USB4 channel performance remain unqualified. No substitution.

X5R_alternative_assessment.tighter_tolerance_search: No exact 0201, 25 V, 330 nF X5R +/-5% alternative verified in the checked catalog and distributor searches. Keyword searches returned near matches and do not establish global unavailability.
X5R_alternative_assessment.RX_limitation: 330 nF +/-10% spans 297-363 nF at specified measurement conditions, before temperature, DC bias and aging. It does not guarantee the USB-IF 300-363 nF RX interval.

RX_tolerance_followup.result: No better 0201 replacement verified. Smallest tighter-tolerance catalog candidate verified is EIA 0603 Yageo CC0603JRX7R8BB334. No circuit substitution.

RX_deeper_search.result: No verified off-the-shelf 0201 >=25 V part whose initial tolerance guarantees 300-363 nF. A stronger stated cold-temperature limit was verified for Samsung CL03A334KA3NRNC, JLCPCB C2980695. No circuit change.
RX_deeper_search.scope_limitation: The checked catalogs, model lists and search results do not prove global unavailability. A generic tolerance code or a syntactically plausible MPN does not establish a purchasable part.

No 330 nF selection row; 25 V X5R 100 nF excludes +/-5%. No target established.

Class II X7R range table limits EIA 0201 at 25 V to 10 nF. No target established.

BOM assigns 330 nF, 0201, 6.3 V to C32-C35. It does not resolve the >=25 V target. Public work-in-progress design, not ASMedia qualification.

0201 product page ordering table restricts X7R/X5R to K/M (+/-10% or +/-20%). Generic C0G +/-5% code does not apply to those dielectrics.

screening_route.status: Set aside after the user clarified that they want a standard component, not a screening project. Earlier evaluation is historical only.
screening_route.limitations: The standard manufacturer rating stays +/-10%. No process yield, measurement uncertainty, selected lot, provider, MOQ, cost, or JLC handling agreement has been verified. Initial sorting alone does not guarantee post-reflow or operating capacitance.

uncertainty_example.note: Example engineering bound, not a measured instrument specification. Optional upper band trades yield for loss margin; no yield known.

initial_measurement.temperature: Controlled room temperature near 25 C; record actual value.
initial_measurement.conditioning: Murata reference initial-test preparation: 150 +0/-10 C for 1 h, followed by 24 +/-2 h at room temperature. Exact handling/conditioning requires agreement with the manufacturer or screening laboratory.

remaining_variation_budget.note: Shows why initial +/-5% screening alone does not guarantee the operating USB4 interval. Actual combined effects require qualification.

assembly_route.method_under_evaluation: External screening and segregated consignment to JLCPCB. No source or process has been confirmed.

sources.finding: High-dielectric MLCC capacitance decreases with aging. Heating during soldering can restore capacitance and restart aging.
Part rating, test voltage/frequency, specified thermal preparation, and measurement cautions. Soldering-heat change allowances do not guarantee retention of a selected +/-5% band.

Consignment is supported, but electrical quality/function testing is outside the published consignment terms. Same-part stock channel restrictions and attrition apply; exact 0201 handling and screened-lot segregation require confirmation.
Published consignment process exists. This does not establish a quoted or approved screened-0201 process for this project.

Retain the existing direct connection as the working prototype circuit; the selectable reference network alone is not a blocker to other schematic work. The examined datasheet does not explicitly establish powered-off VBUS tolerance; assess VBUS present with ATX/VCCH absent during power design. A divider alone does not resolve powered-off tolerance or provide overvoltage protection.

buck_inductors.status: Selected TI-supported 1 uH filter for 2.5 MHz. Actual bridge load, transients, frequency corners and temperature require checks.

effective_capacitance_screening.assumptions: All selected parts +/-10% initial tolerance, +/-15% temperature change; -50% DC bias is a sensitivity assumption, not a guaranteed lower limit.

buck_output_capacitors.topology: Both local capacitors shunt each filtered output to GND. VOS senses the same output.
buck_output_capacitors.placement_followup: Place both local capacitors near the converter and inductor output; keep the VIN/GND loop short.
buck_output_capacitors.selection_status: Static and LC screening support placement. Actual stability, ripple, startup and load-step response remain unmeasured.

buck_feedback.topology: Filtered output -> Rtop -> FB -> Rbottom -> GND. Separate control loops; MODE selection enables external feedback. EN uses the shared VCCH-qualified BUCK_EN net.

static_budget_assumptions.method: Worst-case opposite resistor errors; sum initial tolerance and drift conservatively. Include leakage in either direction using I_FB * Rtop.
static_budget_assumptions.physical_scope: Resistor reference temperature 25 C, assessed -40 to +150 C; complete board temperature limits are narrower.

buck_feedback.placement_followup: Keep FB short and away from SW and the inductor. Sense at COUT and return the bottom resistor to quiet GND.
buck_feedback.qualification: Static component budget fits both bridge intervals and reserves more than 10 mV at either limit. This is not complete hardware qualification.
remaining_validation: PCB supply and ground drops, ripple and load-step excursions must fit the remaining margins.
Final load current, thermal behavior and startup sequencing remain unverified.
Check effective capacitance and distributed-bank response on the final PCB. Nominal banks are 74.20 uF on VCCL and 75.08 uF on VDD.

superseded_buck_designs.reason: Insufficient worst-case rail margin with the chosen feedback dividers and power-save accuracy.

reference.equation: VOUT = 0.8 V * (1 + Rtop / Rbottom), DEF low
reference.removal_reason: Superseded by TPS62903RPJR in the current board.

feedback.topology: Filtered output -> Rtop -> FB -> Rbottom -> GND/AGND. Both DEF pins grounded for nominal voltage; EN remains grounded.
feedback.placement_followup: Keep FB midpoint short and away from SW/inductor. Return bottom resistor to quiet AGND; take output sense at COUT.
feedback.qualification: Nominal prototype implementation of the accepted approximately 8 uA divider. Not a guaranteed bridge supply across all operating conditions.
voltage_budget_limitations: Initial divider tolerance, internal reference error, FB leakage, resistor TCR, line/load regulation, ripple, routing loss and transients need a final combined budget.

The conservative full-temperature reference/leakage calculation already exceeds the VCCL operating interval before TCR or dynamic effects. Lower divider resistances or a tighter regulator specification may be needed before enabling.

Intervals use worst-case leakage magnitude in either direction as a conservative bound, not a claim that leakage necessarily reverses. Reference accuracy uses PWM specification with VIN >= VOUT + 1 V.

buck_enable.supply_and_manual_reset: VDD and active-low MR connect to VCCH; 100 nF VDD bypass to GND.
buck_enable.output: Open-drain RESET# drives BUCK_EN, with a 10 kohm pull-up to VCCH. Both TPS62903 EN pins connect to BUCK_EN. Separate from ASM_RST_N and both PG outputs.
buck_enable.timing: CT intentionally open: 25 us nominal release delay. This is not a guaranteed maximum delay or proof of complete board startup timing.
buck_enable.scope: Enables both bucks together after VCCH crosses the supervisor rising threshold. Bridge reset/PG qualification and 5 V-to-VCCH timing remain open.
